name: novelist
description: Manage story assets, apply genre-aware writing strategies, maintain continuity, and publish validated EPUBs.

interface.shortDescription: Write coherent novels across every story asset
interface.longDescription: Initialize a Markdown novel workspace, develop settings, characters, materials, plots, and outlines, apply genre-aware storytelling strategies, control continuity and reader understanding, create visual assets, and finish with a validated EPUB.
defaultPrompt: Create a new novel workspace and help me define its premise.
Plan the next chapter with continuity and reader understanding in mind.
Publish the current manuscript as a validated EPUB.
